note: Divergence ratchets for scripts/flix-spec-conformance.mjs. Lower them as divergences are fixed; never raise one without saying why in the commit message. The measurement is only comparable against the flix-spec inputs recorded below -- a different pin or fixture revision is a different question, not a regression. Two ratchets, because there are two derived lanes: `divergences` gates structure modulo error recovery, and `recoveryDivergences` gates error-recovery shape on its own. NOTE: agreement fell from 122 to 107 when the mapping set was completed, because unmapped nodes are skipped rather than compared -- depth rose 84% to 90%. Read fixturesAgreeing together with depthPercent; a high agreement count at low depth is the number to distrust.

oracle_conformance.comment: Structure modulo error recovery. flix-spec normalizes wrapper nodes and the error vocabulary out of fixtures/expected itself now, so ten `elide` entries and one `flattenCanonical` entry were deleted here as dead weight. The result is score-neutral exactly where it had to be: the same 21 positive fixtures diverge as before, none more and none fewer, and depth is unchanged at 99%. What moved is negative -- 67 structural divergences became 61, and types__effect-annotation-wrong-slash stopped diverging here at all, because its disagreement was purely about recovery shape.

recovery_conformance.comment: Error-recovery shape alone, scoped to the 21 fixtures whose raw reference tree contains a recovery marker. Not a regression: this is signal that used to be averaged into one number and is now stated. Our ERROR node lands in different places than the reference's ErrorTree, and unterminated_literal/unterminated_string are named nodes here where the reference emits only an Err token -- a real modelling difference, which is what this lane exists to surface rather than absorb.

source_invariants.comment: document-shape passes. The two vocabulary checks stand down because a projection map is in play, and token-accounting stands down because this adapter emits no token text -- tree-sitter's named-node view has no Flix tokenization behind it. A structural profile, stated rather than implied.
